name: book-realm
description: 书域 · 超级项目平台书

scripts.bdd:api: cucumber-js docs/specs/features/**/*.feature --import tests/bdd/**/*.mjs --tags "@api and not @requires-ai" --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber.html
scripts.bdd:ai: cucumber-js docs/specs/features/**/*.feature --import tests/bdd/**/*.mjs --tags "@api and @requires-ai" --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-ai.html
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run bdd:dry && npm run docs:build
